root_cause: In mv_npu_top, mat_ready is gated by can_accept_last_chunk (depends on hold_row_valid/pp_in_ready), introducing a combinational/progress dependency that can prevent final-chunk acceptance and stall matrix ingress indefinitely. This violates intended streaming progress and causes cocotb send_beat timeout on mat_ready before functional checking.

first_divergence.expected: mat_ready eventually asserts during COMPUTE_ROWS to accept matrix beats.
first_divergence.observed: Both tests fail with SimTimeoutError: timeout waiting mat_ready.

evidence.observation: Failure at line sending matrix beat: timeout waiting mat_ready at 1026ns.
evidence.relevance: First authoritative fatal failure in functional simulation.

evidence.observation: Same timeout waiting mat_ready at matrix send path.
evidence.relevance: Confirms systematic ingress deadlock, not data-specific mismatch.
Direct control condition that can block matrix acceptance based on downstream postproc readiness.

evidence.observation: Build/elaboration pass; only warnings (including latch inference) and no fatal compile errors.
evidence.relevance: Confirms primary failure is runtime protocol/progress, not compile legality.

alternative_hypotheses: Latch-inferred combinational temps in mv_npu_top/mv_mac16_core may cause X/unstable internal values but do not explain earliest mat_ready timeout as directly as gating deadlock.
DONE/out_xfer exit condition interplay in mv_ctrl_fsm could contribute to later completion issues after ingress deadlock is fixed.
